summary: Nanobiotix S.A. filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report, furnishing its half-year 2026 financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026, covering the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, with comparative balance sheet data as of December 31, 2025 and 2024. No special-situation transaction is disclosed: no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, capital return, or strategic review. The exhibit index references share capital, share premium, treasury shares, reserves and net loss data, plus warrant and ADR line items dated May 26, 2026. What to watch: routine interim reporting with no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
